findings.finding: XNU documents matching Xcode and an Apple Silicon KDK; it does not provide a Linux arm64e Apple Clang.
The documented WSL build uses the same XNU revision for plain ARM64 iOS in QEMU; it does not validate macOS arm64e or signed-null ABI.
The checked public Apple branch rejects more than three __ptrauth arguments.
The checked public next revision fixes AuthenticatesNullValues to false.
The documented third-party three-argument workaround changes null pointer storage and authentication behavior and may be incompatible with Apple-compiled kexts.
